title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
desc: Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye! Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!.
howto: Tap on the screen and pull to charge your epic bow area, watch the bow and arrow for direction, and release
Score game points by picking the best angle of attack
The physics in this casual game are very realistic and fun to explore
tips: Timing beats power — wait for the perfect moment.
Learn one mode well before jumping into tournaments.
